75:     def _reference(self, value, column):

limitations: Timer periods specify requested callback cadence, not actual execution intervals or a deterministic ordering with odom.
No fixed 5 Hz C++ state/trajectory refresh can be inferred: the refresh is gated by odom callback execution and early returns.
Python latest state means latest successfully consumed odom available to the node, not necessarily the latest physical or DDS-queued state.
Default single-threaded node executors serialize callbacks, but do not fix timer/odom order or guarantee wall-time deadlines. Python planning additionally runs in a spawned process.
No measured command latency, exact repeated-state count, scheduling jitter or causal attribution for tracking RMSE is provided.
